title: Nest

fields.name: operation
fields.description: Select the operation nest or lift

fields.name: wildcard
fields.description: Nest records which field matches the wildcard

fields.name: nest_under
fields.description: Nest records matching the Wildcard under this key

fields.name: nested_under
fields.description: Lift records nested under the Nested_under key

fields.name: add_prefix
fields.description: Prefix affected keys with this string

fields.name: remove_prefix
fields.description: Remove prefix from affected keys if it matches this string

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Nest Filter plugin lets you operate on or with nested data.
